tickets.objective: Resolves VAL-13. The corpus gate still prints "Suggested move: ... RECOMMENDATION REQUIRING USER APPROVAL" (corpus_diagnostics.py ~760, with supporting text ~48/~767 and the analyze corpus help in tla_spec_dev.py ~612) — prescriptive-move language the epic pivot removed from the scanner but not from this path, and a real validation agent met it mid-ticket. Replace it with a factual finding plus a REDESIGN QUESTION: state what the corpus concentration measures, then prompt the reader to consider whether the architecture can be redesigned to make the program simpler — pointing at the complexity descriptor and references/complexity_intuition.md as the judgment inputs (the CD-02 framing: "take this complexity descriptor to consider how to refactor complexity out of the app"). Nothing is prescribed and nothing is auto-applied. Then SWEEP the whole repository for every remaining case of prescriptive suggestion language the pivot missed (grep-driven inventory: "suggested move", "suggest_move", "recommendation requiring", "apply the suggested", case-insensitive): every occurrence in reachable output, help text, docs, or tests is removed or reworded to the finding+question form; immutable history (specs/.history) is left untouched and listed as exempt. The inventory with per-occurrence disposition is recorded as evidence — the owner's stated concern is that earlier passes did not capture all the cases.

tickets.objective: Resolves VAL-06, VAL-16, VAL-17 — three domain-resolution blind spots that real agents hit in three of six validation runs, each currently degrading the bound to UNKNOWN (or a partial product) on standard patterns. (1) VAL-06: _set_size resolves only literals, int ranges, BOOLEAN, unions, and cfg constants; an operator-defined set (TaskStatus == {...} in an EXTENDS-ed module, used as tasks \in [Names -> TaskStatus]) resolves unknown even though resolve_definition_body has already expanded the operator — consult it (the same transitive resolution CD-01 built for F1). (2) VAL-16: the `variable \in <domain>` regex captures to end-of-line, so a membership conjunct wrapped across lines silently resolves unknown — parse conjunct-wise, not line-wise. (3) VAL-17: domain-source precedence (any TypeInvariant in the EXTENDS hierarchy becomes the sole source, then TypeOK, then cfg invariants) interacts badly with the scaffold's own multi-view layout where TypeInvariant cannot be redefined per view — merge domain sources (per-variable, first resolvable wins with a documented order) instead of first-named-definition-wins, or document the per-view naming convention and make the resolver honor both names. Regression tests for each, failing pre-fix. Document exactly what the resolver can see.
tickets.title: Descriptor accuracy: domain resolution sees operator-defined sets, wrapped conjuncts, and multi-view invariant naming

(6) VAL-18: point README case counts at generated docs.md, flush the regenerate script's command echoes, and document that manual tlc2 runs need -deadlock. Acceptance is the pristine example completing its own documented local (non-k3d) path end to end.

tickets.objective: Resolves VAL-07 and VAL-12 — the same attribution defect from both directions, hit independently in three validation runs. The R/W matrix attributes primed variables to the syntactic primer, so (a) wrapper actions that prime a variable only through a helper operator vanish from the matrix (9 CLI actions collapsed to 4 on taskq), and (b) helper operators are listed AS actions while composed actions whose writes happen entirely through called operators or UNCHANGED get no column (MarkExternal listed, RunFulfillmentWorker absent, on distributed_history). Dense-row fractions, dense columns, action_count, component action counts — and the fitness facts derived from them — are computed over a partially wrong action set. Fix: attribute primes to the top-level action disjuncts (Next/ExternalNext members), expanding called-operator bodies transitively (the CD-01/F1 resolution machinery, extended by CD-05); helpers are not actions. Regression tests covering both shapes, failing pre-fix; verify against the real distributed_history External view and record the corrected matrix as evidence.
tickets.title: Descriptor accuracy: R/W matrix attributed to top-level actions through called operators
